findings.quote: Failure to act promptly can be a ground for administrative disciplinary action. This does not mean a penalty is automatic.
findings.problem: The brief asks for applicable defenses and disciplinary process. This passage says only that proper process applies. It gives no defense or explanation of how circumstances affect a failure-to-respond charge. The nonroutine acknowledgement is taught, but not connected to that assessment.

lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-duties-an.quote: If no deadline is given, the agency must set what counts as reasonable time.
lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-duties-an.note: Agency criteria, legal deadlines, different signature rules, and authorized substitute signers are all taught.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: The alleged violation is handled through the proper administrative process.
general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.note: It says a penalty is not automatic, but does not develop the process or applicable defenses requested by this item.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: It may consider the difficulty of the matter, whether the requirements are complete, resources lost for reasons beyond the office's control, legal orders that stop action, delay caused by the party concerned, and events beyond anyone's control.
general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.note: The text explains who sets reasonable time and lists the circumstances used in that assessment.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: Leaving a person waiting without proper reason can violate this duty.
general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.note: Personal service is explicitly connected to prompt attention and unjustified waiting.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: An office may lawfully withhold information when disclosure would harm national security, put a person's life or safety in danger, reveal protected or privileged information, expose draft decisions, invade personal privacy without proper reason, harm certain law-enforcement work, or cause other harm covered by law or settled policy.
general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.note: Specific access restrictions are named, and the privacy example applies one of them.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: Coverage does not depend on whether the person receives pay.
general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.note: Coverage is distinguished from SALN exemptions, but unpaid coverage alone does not explain the volunteer category or define the listed public-service categories.
